definitions.allocated_wrong_pair_share: Half of every wrong/tied positive-negative pair is allocated to each endpoint. Shares across disjoint generator/month groups sum to one.
definitions.incident_wrong_pair_share: Fraction of wrong/tied pairs touching the slice; overlapping slices cannot be summed.
definitions.same_case_pair_auc: AUC restricted to positive-negative pairs in the same case, weighted by available pairs; diagnostic, not the competition metric.
definitions.limitations: Reused historical development years; labels define diagnostic slices only. Pair errors include half-weight ties. No model or calibration fitting, no test labels.
